[EN] You fool! You cannot hope to defeat me with such a pinprick! I don't care how...wobbly...you make it...to the dance...tippy-tappy.

Tippy-tappy!
[ES] ¡Insensato! ¡No esperes derrotarme con un pinchazo tan insignificante! No me importa lo... tambaleante... que hagas... el baile... con pasitos de tap.

¡Pasitos de tap!

[EN] Forgive me, Lord Dakuryon!

I have betrayed you! Take my life as payment!
[ES] ¡Perdóname, Lord Dakuryon!

¡Te he traicionado! ¡Toma mi vida como pago!
